# splicejam ![](reference/figures/splicejam_logo.png)

Splicejam was created to analyze and visualize RNA-seq and transcript
isoform splicing data. Splicejam aims to provide sashimi plots with
enough customizations to support publication-quality figures.

## Updates 23-July-2026

- Much simpler workflow:

``` R
sjenv <- sashimiDataConstants(
   gtf=gtf,
   filesDF=filesDF)
sashimiFigure(sjenv, gene="Gria1")
```

## Splicejam Sashimi Plot

An example sashimi plot is shown below for the gene *Gria1*. Each panel
shows transcript expression in a region of mouse hippocampus, where
“CA1_CB” shows data that originated from cell bodies of CA1, and
“CA2_CB” shows corresponding data from cell bodies of CA2.

In the example below `sjenvtest` is an `environment` which contains the
data necessary to create a Splicejam sashimi plot.

``` r

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splicejam))
if (suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(GenomicRanges))) {
   data(sjenvtest);
   sjfig <- splicejamFigure(sjenv=sjenvtest,
      gene="Gria1",
      sample_id=c("CA1_CB", "CA2_CB"),
      use_memoise=TRUE,
      minJunctionScore=500)
}
```

![](reference/figures/README-gria1_sashimi-1.png)

![](reference/figures/mouse_hippocampus.png)

A depiction of the CA1 and CA2 regions of mouse hippocampus is shown in
Fig 4a from [Dudek et al. Nature Reviews
Neuroscience(2016)](https://dx.doi.org/10.1038/nrn.2015.22)

  

## Features of a splicejam sashimi plot:

- The dark color polygons represent RNA transcript sequence coverage for
  exons in the Gria1 gene.
- Wide ribbons are drawn to indicate splice junctions, areas where the
  sequences are aligned with a wide gap, typically spanning two exons.
- The thickness of the ribbon (in height) represents the number of
  aligned reads that span the gap, usually about 70-80% the height of
  the adjacent exons.
- The ribbons are shaded light to dark based upon how predominant the
  splice junction is from exon to exon. The darkest ribbons represent
  the most predominant path from exon to exon through the gene.
- Introns are drawn with a fixed width (along the x-axis) and do not use
  genome coordinates. Introns are normally about 100 times wider than
  exons, and when drawn to scale obscure the detailed coverage of the
  exons. The x-axis labels indicate genome coordinates.

## Sashimi plot at closer range

The plot can be zoomed using exon names, and argument `use_exon_range`.

Notice the relative heights of the exons differ across CA1 and CA2,
consistent with the corresponding changes in splice junctions. Clearly
CA1 and CA2 favor different and mutually exclusive exons for Gria1.

``` r

sjfig_zoom <- splicejamFigure(sjenv=sjenvtest,
   gene="Gria1",
   sample_id=c("CA1_CB", "CA2_CB"),
   use_exon_range=c("Gria1_exon13", "Gria1_exon16"),
   use_memoise=TRUE,
   minJunctionScore=500)
```

![](reference/figures/README-gria1_sashimi_zoom-1.png)

Incidentally, these two isoforms of Gria1 represent the [“flop” and
“flip”](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/neuroscience/gria1) forms
of the AMPA receptor complex. In human, the genes Gria2, Gria3, and
Gria4 comprise the AMPA receptor complex, and each genes has two
isoforms with “flop” and “flip” designations.

## Package Reference

A full online function reference is available via the pkgdown
documentation:

Full splicejam command reference: <https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam>

The splicejam package is part of a suite of R packages called “jampack”
which is available through GitHub, see
<https://github.com/jmw86069/jampack>

## How to install

Install using the R package `remotes` and this command:

``` R
remotes::install_github("jmw86069/splicejam")
```

## About sashimi plots

Sashimi plots were originally envisioned by MISO, which introduced the
innovative idea to compress intron width in order to reveal the detailed
exon sequence coverage, and to highlight changes in splice junctions.

Katz, Y, Wang ET, Silterra J, Schwartz S, Wong B, Thorvaldsdóttir H,
Robinson JT, Mesirov JP, Airoldi EM, Burge, CB. *Sashimi plots:
Quantitative visualization of alternative isoform expression from
RNA-seq data.* <http://biorxiv.org/content/early/2014/02/11/002576>

Splicejam re-envisions classic sashimi plots by displaying splice
junctions as wide arcs proportional in size to the number of junction
reads, making them directly comparable to exon coverages on the same
plot. Inspired by:

- [Sankey plots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sankey_diagram),
- [flow diagrams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flow_diagram),
- [Alluvial diagrams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alluvial_diagram).

These ribbons were ultimately made feasible to implement in R thanks to
the package [ggforce](https://ggforce.data-imaginist.com/) which
implemented
[geom_diagonal_wide](https://ggforce.data-imaginist.com/reference/geom_diagonal_wide.html).

# Package index

## Splicejam core functions

These functions are the heart of the splicejam package

- [`launchSashimiApp()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/launchSashimiApp.md)
  : Launch Sashimi R-shiny application
- [`sashimiDataConstants()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/sashimiDataConstants.md)
  : Prepare sashimi plot required data
- [`splicejamFigure()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/splicejamFigure.md)
  : Make Splicejam Sashimi Figure

## Detected transcripts

Method to define detected transcripts, and review results

- [`defineDetectedTx()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/defineDetectedTx.md)
  : Define detected transcripts
- [`detectedTxInfo()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/detectedTxInfo.md)
  : Summarize detected transcript results

## Data import functions

Useful wrapper functions to import genomic data

- [`getGRcoverageFromBw()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/getGRcoverageFromBw.md)
  : Get coverage for GRanges from bigWig files
- [`import_juncs_from_bed()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/import_juncs_from_bed.md)
  : Import splice junction data from BED or SJ.out.tab file
- [`psl2df()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/psl2df.md)
  : Convert PSL alignment to data.frame

## Splicejam Test data

Various data objects to test Splicejam

- [`sjenvtest`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/sjenvtest.md)
  : Splicejam Environment Test Data
- [`test_cov_gr`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/test_cov_gr.md)
  : Sample exon coverage data GRanges
- [`test_cov_wide_gr`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/test_cov_wide_gr.md)
  : Sample exon coverage data GRanges with wide introns
- [`test_exon_gr`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/test_exon_gr.md)
  : Sample exon data GRanges
- [`test_exon_wide_gr`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/test_exon_wide_gr.md)
  : Sample exon data GRanges with wide introns
- [`test_junc_gr`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/test_junc_gr.md)
  : Sample junction data GRangesList
- [`test_junc_wide_gr`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/test_junc_wide_gr.md)
  : Sample junction data GRangesList with wide introns

## Plot utility functions

Several functions, including 3-D BGA plotly function

- [`bgaPlotly3d()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/bgaPlotly3d.md)
  : Create an interactive 3-D BGA plotly visualization
- [`jitter_norm()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/jitter_norm.md)
  : Apply jitter using normal distribution
- [`spline3d()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/spline3d.md)
  : Calculate a spline curve fit in 3-D

## Design functions

Support for statistical design and differential isoform analysis

- [`curateDFtoDF()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/curateDFtoDF.md)
  : Curate data.frame into a data.frame
- [`curateVtoDF()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/curateVtoDF.md)
  : Curate vector into a data.frame
- [`groups2contrasts()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/groups2contrasts.md)
  : Define experimental contrasts from sample groups
- [`runDiffSplice()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/runDiffSplice.md)
  : Perform differential isoform analysis using diffSplice
- [`sortSamples()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/sortSamples.md)
  : Sort biological sample labels for experimental design

## GenomicRanges functions

GenomicRanges utilities, such as annotating one GR or GRL from another

- [`addGRgaps()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/addGRgaps.md)
  : Add gaps between GRanges regions
- [`addGRLgaps()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/addGRLgaps.md)
  : Add gaps between GRangesList regions
- [`annotateGRfromGR()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/annotateGRfromGR.md)
  : Annotate GRanges using another GRanges object
- [`annotateGRLfromGRL()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/annotateGRLfromGRL.md)
  : Annotate GRangesList from GRangesList objects
- [`assignGRLexonNames()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/assignGRLexonNames.md)
  : Assign exon names to GRangesList
- [`closestExonToJunctions()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/closestExonToJunctions.md)
  : Find closest exon to splice junction ends
- [`findOverlapsGRL()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/findOverlapsGRL.md)
  : Find overlaps between two GRangesList objects
- [`flattenExonsBy()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/flattenExonsBy.md)
  : Flatten exons by gene or transcript
- [`getGRgaps()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/getGRgaps.md)
  : Get gaps in GRanges
- [`getGRLgaps()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/getGRLgaps.md)
  : Get gaps in GRangesList objects
- [`jam_isDisjoint()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/jam_isDisjoint.md)
  : Test whether GRanges are disjoint (non-overlapping)
- [`sortGRL()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/sortGRL.md)
  : Sort GRangesList elements by chromosome and position
- [`spliceGR2junctionDF()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/spliceGR2junctionDF.md)
  : Splice junction data.frame summary

## GTF functions

Gene-exon structure (GTF) file parsing to tx2gene data.frame, and
others.

- [`describeGtfAttrNames()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/describeGtfAttrNames.md)
  : describe gtf/gff3 attribute names by feature type
- [`getGtfAttrs()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/getGtfAttrs.md)
  : Grab GTF or GFF3 attributes into a data.frame
- [`makeTx2geneFromGtf()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/makeTx2geneFromGtf.md)
  : Make tx2gene data.frame from a GTF file
- [`readGtf()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/readGtf.md)
  : read gtf/gff3 file

## ALE and codon functions

Functions supporting Farris et al, alternate last exon (ALE) and codon
usage analysis.

- [`ale2violin()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/ale2violin.md)
  : Prepare ALE data for violin plots
- [`codonUsage2df()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/codonUsage2df.md)
  : Make codon usage data.frame
- [`dna2codon()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/dna2codon.md)
  : Convert DNA to 3-base codons
- [`getFirstStrandedFromGRL()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/getFirstStrandedFromGRL.md)
  : Get first stranded GRanges feature per GRangesList
- [`jamCai()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/jamCai.md)
  : Calculate Codon Adaptation Index
- [`tx2ale()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/tx2ale.md)
  : tx2ale: detect alternative last exons (ALE) from transcript data

## Shiny prep functions

Functions to prepare the Splicejam R-shiny app

- [`sashimiAppConstants()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/sashimiAppConstants.md)
  : Sashimi Shiny app constants
- [`sashimiAppServer()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/sashimiAppServer.md)
  : Sashimi Shiny app server
- [`sashimiAppUI()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/sashimiAppUI.md)
  : Sashimi Shiny app UI

## Sashimi prep functions

Functions to prepare the Sashimi data and plot objects

- [`exoncov2polygon()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/exoncov2polygon.md)
  : Convert exon coverage to polygons
- [`gene2gg()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/gene2gg.md)
  : Gene GRangesList to ggplot2 grob
- [`grl2df()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/grl2df.md)
  : GRangesList to data.frame for ggplot2
- [`make_ref2compressed()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/make_ref2compressed.md)
  : Create a ref2compressed function to compress GR gaps
- [`plotSashimi()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/plotSashimi.md)
  : Jam Sashimi plot
- [`prepareSashimi()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/prepareSashimi.md)
  : Prepare Sashimi plot data

## ggplot2 customizations

Customizations to ggplot2 objects for Sashimi visualizations

- [`stat_diagonal_wide_arc()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/geom_diagonal_wide_arc.md)
  [`geom_diagonal_wide_arc()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/geom_diagonal_wide_arc.md)
  : Draw an area defined by an upper and lower diagonal into an arc
- [`splicejam-extensions`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/splicejam-extensions.md)
  [`StatDiagonalWideArc`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/splicejam-extensions.md)
  : splicejam extensions to ggforce
- [`stat_unpack_polygon()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/stat_unpack_polygon.md)
  : Stat for unpacking list-column polygon coordinates
- [`to_basic(`*`<GeomShape>`*`)`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/to_basic.GeomShape.md)
  : Support plotly for GeomShape

## Internal utility functions

Numerous utility functions, mostly for internal use within Splicejam

- [`combineGRcoverage()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/combineGRcoverage.md)
  : Combine GRanges coverage replicates
- [`compressPolygonM()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/compressPolygonM.md)
  : Compress genome coordinates of a matrix of polygons
- [`df2colorSub()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/df2colorSub.md)
  : Convert data.frame to categorical colors
- [`dfWide2segments()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/dfWide2segments.md)
  : Convert data.frame to plotly line segment format
- [`escapeWhitespaceRegexp()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/escapeWhitespaceRegexp.md)
  : Escape whitespace in regular expression patterns
- [`factor2label()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/factor2label.md)
  : Convert factor to a factor label
- [`geomean()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/geomean.md)
  : Classical geometric mean
- [`intercalate()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/intercalate.md)
  : Intercalate list values into a vector
- [`internal_junc_score()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/internal_junc_score.md)
  : maximum overlapping internal junction score
- [`jamGeomean()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/jamGeomean.md)
  : Modified geometric mean for positive and negative values
- [`list2im()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/list2im.md)
  : Convert list to incidence matrix
- [`shrinkMatrix()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/shrinkMatrix.md)
  : Shrink numeric matrix by groups of rows
- [`simplifyXY()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/simplifyXY.md)
  : Simplify XY coordinates to minimal line segments
- [`stackJunctions()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/stackJunctions.md)
  : Stack the y-axis position of junctions
- [`strsplitOrdered()`](https://jmw86069.github.io/splicejam/reference/strsplitOrdered.md)
  : Split the elements of an ordered factor vector
